name: ros2-project-mentor
description: ROS2 project planning, runnable C++/Python package generation, robot debugging, and adaptive technical teaching.

displayDescription.en: Plans ROS2 projects, generates C++/Python packages, diagnoses communication and simulation issues, and teaches robot development through runnable examples.
displayDescription.zh: 提供ROS2项目规划、双语言功能包生成、通信排障与分层教学，交付结构规范、可构建运行的机器人工程。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Help me plan a ROS2 Humble project: define the package structure, nodes, topics and message types, then provide complete runnable code and verification steps.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我规划一个ROS2 Humble项目：设计功能包结构、节点、话题和消息类型，并给出完整可运行代码与验证步骤。

quickPrompts.en: Help me plan a ROS2 Humble project: define the package structure, nodes, topics and message types, then provide complete runnable code and verification steps.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我规划一个ROS2 Humble项目：设计功能包结构、节点、话题和消息类型，并给出完整可运行代码与验证步骤。

quickPrompts.en: Generate a ROS2 C++ package using a custom message for publisher-subscriber communication, including interfaces, build files, launch and tests.
quickPrompts.zh: 生成一个使用自定义消息的ROS2 C++发布订阅功能包，包含接口、构建文件、launch和测试。

quickPrompts.en: My ROS2 simulation has a problem. Analyze the cause from my logs, provide diagnostic commands and a minimal fix, and explain the underlying concepts.
quickPrompts.zh: 我的ROS2仿真出错了。请根据日志定位原因，给出诊断命令和最小修复，并讲清相关知识点。
